title: ML ranking identifies active sesquiterpene-synthase variants
summary: A composite score combines Boltz2-predicted binding and DLKcat-predicted turnover to rank variants in a focused Agr5 library. Of 15 top-ranked variants tested, four produced more viridiflorol than wild-type Agr5; the paper reports 11.05-fold higher production for Y374F and a 952.79 mg/L titer in its yeast assay. The initial V314G design involved mechanism-guided human analysis, and the measured values are assay-specific.
ai_technology: DeEnzyme_score combining Boltz2 and DLKcat predictions

evidence.tested: The article reports four activity-enhancing variants among 15 tested and specifies the Y374F production ratio and titer in a yeast assay.
evidence.unknown: Prior sequence-level overlap, earlier disclosure and independent replication remain unestablished; the proposed allosteric explanation partly relies on simulation.
evidence.ai_role: Boltz2 and DLKcat predictions are combined to rank variants selected for experimental testing; the initial V314G design is attributed to mechanism-guided analysis, not AI.

source_review.scope: Publisher indexed full article text including title, methods, results, article history and author-affiliation block; direct ACS endpoint returned 403.
